documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

analysis.summary: Emmvee Photovoltaic Power Limited reported strong Q1 FY27 results with revenue of INR 1,555 crores and an EBITDA margin of 35%. The company achieved record production levels for both solar modules and cells, supported by improved operational efficiencies and increased cell utilization. Management highlighted a robust order book of 9.9 gigawatts and confirmed that ongoing capacity expansion projects are progressing according to plan. The company remains focused on maintaining financial discipline and executing its integrated manufacturing strategy. Emmvee Photovoltaic Power Limited reported a strong Q1 FY2027 performance with revenue of INR 15,555 million, representing a 51% year-on-year increase.

guidance.claim: The company is targeting an EBITDA of approximately INR 2,400 crore by the end of FY27.
guidance.quote: We are targeting approximately INR 2,400 crore of an EBITDA by the close of FY27.

demand_outlook.claim: Management expects DCR demand to strengthen throughout FY2027 as projects align with ALMM requirements.
demand_outlook.quote: We expect DCR demand to strengthen progressively during FY2027 as grandfathered non-DCR projects are completed and procurement aligned with ALMM requirements becomes more broad-based.

capex_expansion.claim: The 6-gigawatt integrated TOPCon cell and module facility is expected to be commissioned by December 2026 for modules and March 2027 for cells.
capex_expansion.quote: The module line is expected to be commissioned by December 2026, followed by the cell line by March 2027.

capex_expansion.claim: The total project cost for the 6-gigawatt expansion is estimated at approximately INR 5,500 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: The total project cost is estimated at approximately INR 5,500 crores, including hard costs of around INR 4,600 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: The company plans to backward integrate into ingot and wafer manufacturing in two phases, targeting 5 gigawatts in FY2029 and 4 gigawatts in FY2030.
capex_expansion.quote: The proposed facility will have a total of 9 gigawatt and is planned in two phases, with 5 gigawatt targeted in FY2029 and the remaining 4 gigawatt in FY2030.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's order book stood at 9.9 gigawatts at the end of Q1 FY27.
orders_capacity.quote: Our order book further strengthened to 9.9 gigawatt, supported by fresh order inflows and approximately 1.5 gigawatt.

orders_capacity.claim: Current installed capacity is 10.3 gigawatts of solar modules and 2.94 gigawatts of TOPCon cells.
orders_capacity.quote: Our current installed capacity stands at 10.3 gigawatt of solar modules and 2.94 gigawatt of TOPCon cells.

capital_allocation.claim: Debt funding of approximately INR 3,300 crores for the expansion has been secured at a cost of less than 8%.
capital_allocation.quote: Debt funding of approximately INR 3,300 crores has been tied up at the cost of less than 8%.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that geopolitical issues have led to a strategic increase in raw material inventory.
risks_headwinds.quote: And added to that, this quarter we have strategically kept little more raw material inventory. Reason being the geopolitical issues what is taking place.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management identified risks including fluctuations in earnings, market growth, intense competition, and changes in regulatory environments.
risks_headwinds.quote: These forward-looking statements are based on certain expectations, assumptions, anticipated developments and other factors which are not limited to, risk and uncertainties regarding fluctuations in earnings, market growth, intense competition and the pricing environment in the market, consumption level, ability to maintain and manage key customer relationship and supply chain sources and those factors which may affect our ability to implement business strategies successfully, namely changes in regulatory environments, political instability, change in international oil prices and input costs and new or changed priorities of the trade.

management_commitments.claim: Commission the module line of the 6-gigawatt facility by December 2026.
management_commitments.quote: The module line is expected to be commissioned by December 2026

management_commitments.claim: Commission the cell line of the 6-gigawatt facility by March 2027.
management_commitments.quote: followed by the cell line by March 2027.

management_commitments.claim: Achieve 5 gigawatts of ingot and wafer capacity by FY2029.
management_commitments.quote: The proposed facility will have a total of 9 gigawatt and is planned in two phases, with 5 gigawatt targeted in FY2029
